name: Diamonds: Three-Hand Vault
summary: A three-player trick-taking game over 3 hands of 7 tricks. Winning tricks, and playing off-suit, trigger suit actions that move crystals into your showroom (worth 1 each) and your vault (worth 2 each).

setup: Seats 1, 2 and 3 sit clockwise; the left of seat s is seat (s mod 3) + 1.
Every player's showroom and vault start at 0, and score at 0.

round.effect: When trick_number == 1: deck = all 32 cards; set_aside = []; every player's hand = []; dealer_seat = hand_number; leader_seat = (dealer_seat mod 3) + 1; reset each player's tricks_won, won_diamonds, won_hearts, won_spades and won_clubs to 0. Announce the new hand and its dealer.
When trick_number == 1: deal 7 cards to each player, each one a random draw removed from deck and appended to that player's hand. Then move the remaining 11 deck cards to set_aside.
When trick_number == 1: each player privately sees their own hand, sorted by suit D,H,S,C and then by ascending rank.

round.answer: one card from your own hand
round.effect: When trick_number == 1: store the answer in pass_card. Nobody sees another player's choice.

When trick_number == 1: at once, for each seat s, remove pass_card from s.hand and append it to the hand of seat (s mod 3) + 1. Each receiver is told privately which card they received; the third player is not told.
When trick_number == 1: each player sees their updated sorted hand.
Remove the card from hand; played_card = the card; append it to trick_cards; led_suit = its suit letter. Announce the card to all.

round.effect: Remove the card from hand; played_card = the card; append it to trick_cards; announce it to all.
If that seat's played_card suit != led_suit, the seat takes the action of the played card's suit (see rules R14-R17) at once. Announce the action and its result.

round.effect: Remove the card from hand; played_card = the card; append it to trick_cards; announce it to all.
If that seat's played_card suit != led_suit, the seat takes the action of the played card's suit at once. Announce the action and its result.

trick_winner = the seat whose played_card has suit == led_suit and the highest rank. The winner gets tricks_won += 1, and for each suit, won_<suit> += the count of that suit in trick_cards. The winner then takes the action of led_suit once. Announce the winner, the action and its result.

When trick_number == 7, end of hand, resolved in order: for suit in Diamonds, Hearts, Spades, Clubs, if exactly one player has the strictly highest won_<suit>, that player takes that suit's action once. Then each player with tricks_won == 0 takes the Diamonds action twice (vault += 2). Announce every action.
When trick_number == 7 and hand_number == 3: score = 2 * vault + showroom. Announce scores and vaults.
rounds_played += 1. If trick_number == 7, then hand_number += 1 and trick_number = 1; otherwise trick_number += 1 and leader_seat = trick_winner.
End the game if rounds_played >= 21; otherwise continue.

ending.decided_by: Highest score (2 * vault + showroom) after 3 hands wins. A tie on score is broken by more vault crystals. Players still tied share the win, which is the draw.

rules.text: When the game starts, every player's showroom and vault are 0.
When a hand starts, all 32 cards are shuffled, each player receives 7 cards into their hand, and the other 11 go to set_aside, unseen.
When a hand starts, each player simultaneously passes exactly 1 card from their hand to the seat on their left, and the third player is not told which card was passed.
When a hand starts, every player's tricks_won and won_diamonds, won_hearts, won_spades and won_clubs are reset to 0.
In hand h, the dealer is seat h (hand 1: seat 1, hand 2: seat 2, hand 3: seat 3).
On trick 1 of a hand, the seat left of the dealer leads; on later tricks, the previous trick's winner leads.
When the leader plays a card, its suit becomes led_suit, and the other two players then play in clockwise order.
When a player holds a card of led_suit, they may only play a card of led_suit.
When a non-leader holds no card of led_suit, they may play any card, and they immediately take that card's suit action before the next player plays.
When all 3 cards are played, the highest-ranked card of led_suit wins the trick, and an off-suit card never wins.
When a player wins a trick, their tricks_won increases by 1, and each won_<suit> increases by the number of that suit among the 3 trick cards.
When a player wins a trick, they take the action of led_suit once and lead the next trick.
When the Diamonds action is taken, the taker's vault increases by 1 from the supply.
When the Hearts action is taken, the taker's showroom increases by 1 from the supply.
When the Spades action is taken and the taker's showroom >= 1, their showroom decreases by 1 and their vault increases by 1; when their showroom is 0, nothing happens.
When the Clubs action is taken, 1 crystal moves from the opponent with the largest showroom into the taker's showroom; if both opponents' showrooms are 0, nothing happens.
When the Clubs action is taken and both opponents tie for the largest showroom (above 0), the crystal is taken from the tied opponent seated first clockwise after the taker.

When trick 7 of a hand ends, for each suit in the order Diamonds, Hearts, Spades, Clubs, the single player with strictly the most won cards of that suit takes that suit's action once; if the top count is tied, nobody takes it.
When trick 7 of a hand ends, after the suit-majority actions, each player with tricks_won == 0 takes the Diamonds action twice (vault += 2).
When hand 3 ends (after 21 tricks), each player's score = 2 * vault + showroom, and the game ends.
When the game ends, the highest score wins; a tie is broken by the larger vault; players still tied share the win as a draw.
When a card is played or a suit action resolves, the card and the action's result are announced to all players, and showroom counts are always public.

choices.why: The designer fixed the game at 3. Seat-based dealer rotation, passing left and the Clubs tie-break all assume 3 seats.

A thoughtful player chooses when to void a suit so that off-suit plays trigger Diamonds or Clubs actions. They track opponents' showrooms to time Clubs and Spades, and weigh winning suit majorities against deliberately taking zero tricks for the +2 vault bonus.
The source rules include no table talk, and adding it would add a mechanic.

choices.what: Cards encoded as text 'D7', 'H3', and so on
choices.why: The suit letter and rank can then be read arithmetically to find led_suit and the trick winner.
No score can reach 1000 in 21 tricks, so this ranks by score first and vault second. Equal values share the win, which matches the source's draw.

choices.what: Final scores computed in a step when hand 3's trick 7 ends
choices.why: The source scores only at the end of hand 3.

simplifications.why: The source leaves vaults out of summaries, but every vault change is announced to everyone, so vaults are fully trackable. Public visibility gives the same information.

simplifications.what: The trick is played as three separate ask steps addressed by seat expressions relative to leader_seat, each follower's ask followed by an update for an off-suit action
simplifications.why: The engine's step list is flat. This keeps clockwise order from a variable leader and resolves each off-suit action before the next player plays.

simplifications.what: Start-of-hand dealing and passing run as steps guarded by trick_number == 1
simplifications.why: One round is one trick, so the hand-start steps run only on the first trick of each hand.

simplifications.what: Won cards are tracked only as per-suit counts, not as a pile of cards
simplifications.why: The rules use won cards only through their per-suit counts.
